body.html: What makes At The Beach Koh Larn Resort an easy pick is its location right by Na Ban Pier. Take the ferry across from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya, land at Na Ban, and it's roughly a 2-minute walk to the resort — no songthaew transfer, no hauling luggage up a hill. It suits travellers who want to spend their Koh Larn time on the beaches rather than getting around the island, and who'd rather drop their bags first and head straight out.

The setting here is shaded by mature trees. Guest reviews agree on this: there's plenty of shade, so walking around the grounds doesn't feel as hot as open, sun-baked properties. Rooms are air-conditioned, with a Standard Queen of around 21 sqm on the ground floor and Superior rooms on the first and second floors. They're simple and clean, with a private bathroom, TV and free Wi-Fi. With around 18 rooms it's a small, quiet, fairly private place to stay.

"Clean room, the staff were really helpful with tips on where to go, and there are bikes to rent right at the resort so you don't have to find one at the pier. It's just a short walk from the ferry. Quiet and easy."

Real guest reviews line up on staff and convenience. Many praise the friendly, helpful team — for tips on where to go, arranging transport, and sorting out motorbike rental on site so you don't have to hunt for one at the pier. There's an on-site restaurant, a shuttle service, and parking (around ฿100 entry). The wallet-friendly price comes up often too.

One thing to know before booking: despite the name, At The Beach is not right on the sand. The resort sits on the Na Ban Pier side, about 1.1 km from Tawaen Beach, so you'll want a motorbike or a ride to reach the water. Some reviews also flag ants in the rooms, showers that lack a little privacy, and patchy housekeeping in places — dust or linens that aren't always fresh. If you run into any of that, raise it with staff; most issues get handled.

Honestly, At The Beach Koh Larn Resort is best for travellers who want a budget-friendly room close to the pier, leafy and shaded, without travelling far across the island. If your picture of Koh Larn is landing easy, walking to your room, dropping your bags, then renting a bike to hop between Tawaen, Samae and the other beaches — this fits at a fair price. But if you want a stay right on the sand, or expect a polished new hotel room, a property on Tawaen or Samae Beach itself will suit you better.

On price, weekday deals can dip into the high hundreds, but a typical standard-room rate sits around ฿1,500/night. Superior rooms and weekends or long holidays climb to roughly ฿1,800–2,500, and the place fills fast as there are only a handful of rooms. If you're going over a holiday, book ahead, compare a few platforms since rates swing a lot by date, and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: FAQ — At The Beach Koh Larn Resort

faq.q: Where is At The Beach Koh Larn Resort on the island?
faq.a: It's on the Na Ban Pier side of Koh Larn, in Bang Lamung, Chon Buri — about a 2-minute walk from Na Ban Pier. Tawaen Beach is roughly 1.1 km away, so you'll want a motorbike or a ride to reach the water. The shops and restaurants of Na Ban village are within walking distance.

faq.q: Is At The Beach Koh Larn Resort on the beach?
faq.a: No, it's not right on the sand despite the name. The resort sits on the Na Ban Pier side, about 1.1 km from Tawaen Beach. Its strength is being close to the pier — you can walk to your room straight off the ferry — and bikes are for hire out front to reach the beaches.

faq.q: How much does At The Beach Koh Larn Resort cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: A typical rate starts around ฿1,500/night for a Standard Queen Room of about 21 sqm. Superior rooms run around ฿1,800, and weekends or long holidays climb to roughly ฿2,500. Weekday deals can be cheaper — rates swing a lot by date, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does At The Beach Koh Larn Resort have motorbikes for hire?
faq.a: Yes, motorbikes are for hire at the resort itself — a point reviews praise often, since you don't have to find one at the pier. From there you can ride to Tawaen, Samae and Nual beaches and the island viewpoints with ease.

faq.q: How do I get to At The Beach Koh Larn Resort?
faq.a: Take the ferry across from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes). From the pier it's roughly a 2-minute walk to the resort — no transfer needed. On the island, renting a motorbike at the resort is the easiest way to get around the beaches.

faq.q: Who is At The Beach Koh Larn Resort best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a budget-friendly room near the pier, leafy surroundings, and minimal getting-around on the island — land easy, walk to your room, drop your bags, then rent a bike for the beaches. It's less suited to those who want a beachfront stay on the sand or expect a polished, modern hotel room.
